name: Hive 1.5.1
notes: Fixes messages being silently dropped between teammates. When a device's identity transitions (e.g. a local id that later signs into GitHub), it holds a valid device certificate under each account — but verify-on-ingest only recognized one, so the other account's events were quarantined as 'Impersonation' and never applied. A device may now sign as any account it's cert-verified to (each certificate is signed by that account's own key, so it can't be forged), so cross-teammate messages flow instead of being dropped.
